title: Three-phase distribution board
goal: A reader must be able to trace a three-pole incomer to four phase-balanced RCBO final circuits and identify neutral and earth bars.

rubric.must: L1, L2, and L3 each pass through one visibly grouped 63 A main-breaker pole.
Four separate blocks labelled RCBO1 through RCBO4 each show a line, neutral, and load connection.
The RCBO labels visibly assign circuits to L1, L2, L3, and L1 respectively.
Lighting, sockets, HVAC, and kitchen loads are separately shown downstream of their respective RCBOs.
A labelled NEUTRAL BAR is visible on the shared N return.
A separate labelled EARTH BAR with PE marking is visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Three-pole incomer with a dashed common-operation link, four RCBOs fed from L1/L2/L3/L1, separate neutral and earth bars, TN-S and the phase assignment stated on the drawing.
